name: ptaskcpl
description: HARDWARE TASK SWITCH where the OUTGOING task runs at CPL3 (the CWSDPMI 0x60<->0x70 co-routine pattern). TASK1 drops to CPL3 (cs=0x1B, a DPL3 alias of CPL0 0x08, RPL3), does ljmp $0x33 (task switch to TSS2, DPL3) -> the CPU SAVES cs=0x1B into TSS1+0x4C; TASK2 (CPL0) runs then ljmp $0x28 back -> TASK1 RESUMES from its saved TSS1 image at cs=0x1B, CPL=3. Proves the TSS save/restore of a CPL3 code selector is bit-exact to qemu (the exact mechanism the DOS-Quake #DE blames). Records: resumed CS selector (0x1B) + the saved TSS1 CS byte (0x1B). Exits via OUT 0xf4 from CPL3 (IOPL=3).
